event_name: NHRA New England Nationals presented by bproauto

pairs.note:
Weather conditions: air temperature 75 degrees, relative humidity 63 percent, barometer 29.66 inches, adjusted
altitude 2,056 feet, track temperature 96 degrees.

The last time Matt Hagan raced Del Worsham was Las Vegas-2, 2017.   Del Worsham is 317 - 225 (58%) in Rd. 1
races.

Worsham goes red and then the car is out of the groove and collects the centerline blocks to give Hagan the
win.

Hagan is up in smoke right at the hit and pedaled it one time, but was back up in smoke before  he clicked it
off.  He still gets the win.

J.R. Todd wins 67% of his Rd. 1 races when he has lane choice.  Spencer Hyde is 14 - 10 in Rd. 1 in FC.

Todd is 2 - 1 against Hyde in prior events. 

Hyde with the starting line advantage, but is up in smoke right at the hit.

Todd kept it hooked up and hitting on all eight to make the second quickest pass of the weekend for the win.

Jack Beckman wins 78% of his Rd. 1 races when he has lane choice.  Phil Burkart beat Bob Tasca in Rd. 1 here
last year.

Beckman is 2 - 0 against Burkart in prior events.

Beckman with the starting line advantage and never trailed for the win.  He kept it hooked up for the win.  He
will have lane choice over Hagan in the next round.

Burkart is up in smoke right at the hit and clicked it off.

Jordan Vandergriff is the 100th FC driver to qualify #1.  Jeff Arend is 4 - 22 in Rd. 1 when #16.

Vandergriff is 1 - 0 against Arend in prior events. 

Vandergriff with the starting line advantage and never trailed for the win.

Arend with a good pass until on the top end when the car moved out of the groove and collected the centerline
blocks.  This will cost him 10 points.

at this event.

DeJoria is 15 - 12 against Pedregon in prior events. 

DeJoria with the starting line advantage and is straight down the groove for the win.

Pedregon is loose right at the hit and the car drops a cylinder and it makes a quick move toward the
centerline and collects the centerline blocks.  This is the second time Pedregon has a centerline violation,
so it will cost 20 points.

Austin Prock is 6 - 1 in his last 2 races.  In FC Blake Alexander is 49 - 79 in Rd. 1

Prock is 4 - 1 against Alexander in prior events.

Prock with the starting line advantage, but started to lose traction and did a great pedal job.
Alexander with a good pass early, but started to haze the tires on the top end.  He holds on for the win.  He
will give up lane choice to Todd in the next round.

Ron Capps is 4 - 0 against Wilkerson in Rd.1.  In his last 5 races Daniel Wilkerson is 0 - 5 in Rd. 1

Capps is 8 - 2 against Wilkerson in prior events. 

Wilkerson with the starting line advantage, but is up in smoke right at the hit and clicked it off.

Capps launched hard and kept it hooked up to make the third quickest pass of the round.  He will have lane
choice over DeJoria in the next round.

Chad Green is #8 and the #8 FC qualifier is 7 - 5 in Rd. 1 here. Dave Richards is making his 84th start.

Green is 1 - 0 against Richards in prior events.

Richards with problems getting the car to fire, Green waits for him.  Green is told to fire the car and he has
a problem getting the car to fir.  

He gets the car to fire and Richards can't get the car to fire, so Green has the solo.

He launched hard and kept it hooked to make his quickest pass of the weekend.  He will give up lane choice to
Vandergriff by 0.004 seconds.
